analysis: Two failures (soft_afternoon, soft_any_doctor, indirect_preference) show PREFERENCE_MISSED because honor_soft_preferences is false, meaning soft preferences like afternoon visits are not being used to rank available appointment slots. Setting honor_soft_preferences to true fixes this. Another failure (transient_availability) shows a READ_TRANSIENT_UNRECOVERED failure because read_retries is 0 and transient read errors on search_slots fail immediately; setting read_retries to 1 or 2 allows the system to retry transient read failures.

patches.reason: Enables ranking and selection of available slots based on retained user soft preferences such as preferred afternoon times.
Allows retrying transient read errors when calling clinic tools like search_slots to recover from temporary availability outages.
